TestSession.title: TestSession
TestSession.description: Represents an SR test session, either in-progress or completed.

userId.description: ID of the user who owns this test session

currentStep.description: The current question step index for paused tests

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in test

testData.description: The complete test data JSON including questions and passages

/testSessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of SR test sessions created by users.
